game.q: you’re the king. you want a ruler, not a monk. what’s the plan?
opts: keep every sad sight away from him
hand him a tablet and hope
build a moat. a big one.

wrong.tablet: screens weren’t invented yet. close in spirit, though.
wrong.moat: bigger than a moat. a whole palace bubble.

game.right: YES. palaces, no sickness, no old age in sight. it only made the first glimpse hit harder.

end.line: a queen dreamed of a white elephant. the wise men said: a son is coming.
end.l1: a queen dreamed a white elephant.
end.l2: the wise men said: a son.
